description: This file defines the jQuery.Callbacks function, which creates a callback list with configurable options such as once, memory, unique, and stopOnFalse. It manages callback registration, removal, firing, and state management.

methods.name: createOptions
methods.description: Converts string options into an object with boolean flags.

methods.name: fire
methods.description: Executes all callbacks in the list respecting the current state and options.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds one or more callbacks to the list, with support for recursive addition.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes specified callbacks from the list.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks if a callback is in the list.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Removes all callbacks from the list.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Disables the callback list, preventing further firing or modification.

methods.name: disabled
methods.description: Checks if the callback list is disabled.

methods.name: lock
methods.description: Locks the callback list, preventing further firing but retaining callbacks.

methods.name: locked
methods.description: Checks if the callback list is locked.

methods.name: fireWith
methods.description: Fires callbacks with a specific context and arguments.

methods.name: fire
methods.description: Fires callbacks with the current context and arguments.

methods.name: fired
methods.description: Checks if the callbacks have been fired at least once.
